title: pm-dispatch: tooling cards capped at 10% of a dispatch round, pm-rule cards only when the maintainer names them, two new round-report readings; and a spec key lands with its first reader (maintainer rulings D3 = A, D5 = A)
body:
Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed. Tesla ruled the whole-project assessment's D3 and D5 on 2026-10-25 09:23Z in the director thread, answering the option lists: 「D4 · 固定发版日 没必要；其他同意 ，npm dist-tag 手工清理 应该立一张管理者维护的卡」 — "其他同意" = D3 A and D5 A as recommended. This is the per-change maintainer authorisation the skill's red line requires for a `.claude/` PR; quote it in the PR body. ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

Governing text: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (〈升级与决策〉 four axes: "新增门禁默认否"), `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` rule 2 ("跨层功能点 … spec/后端先行"), `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈轮次报告与节奏〉.

## D3 = A, as ruled

- A dispatch round carries at most 10% `tooling` cards (tooling / skills / CI / process). Overflow stays in the backlog, ⛔ not `pm:queue`.
- A new card that adds or changes a pm rule is filed only when the maintainer names it (quote the naming in the card).
- Every round report adds two readings: the product-commit share (merged commits outside `.claude/`, `AGENTS.md`, `scripts/pm`, gate scripts, `.github/workflows`) and the count of follow-up PRs opened within 48 h of a landed PR.
- ⛔ No gate, no script that enforces the cap — Tesla's option text says 不做门禁. The readings are reported, not checked.

## D5 = A, as ruled

- A spec key lands in the same PR, or the same merge batch, as its first reader; a `planned` liveness row no longer reaches `main` on its own. Replaces rule 2's "spec/后端先行" ordering for new keys.
- Effective once objectui lives in this repo (the ui/ cutover of the objectui-merge epic); before that a cross-repo reader cannot share a PR. hotcrm readers stay cross-repo and use "same merge batch".
- The rule text may land before the cutover, carrying that condition in words a seat can check (does `ui/` exist on `main`).

## Business rationale

- D3: 17.1% of objectstack's merged commits over 14 days served the process itself and 34% of new cards were tooling/skills/devx (assessment D3). Product work is what customers pull; the cap is the only brake on process cards breeding process cards.
- D5: one feature (dataset dimension `nullLabel`) took four PRs over three landings because the key had to land first as `planned` with no reader. Declared-without-reader is exactly the gap the spec's "declare = enforce" rule forbids.

## For the dev

- File surface: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` only (Tier S, `.claude/**`). The line ratchet (`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`) covers every file of the surface: pay new lines with deletions in the same file, ⛔ no re-wrap to make room, no ceiling raise (Tesla named none). `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`: no issue numbers in the rule text.
- One PR for both rulings: same file family, serial anyway. If the `area:*` / tooling-slot text that #20957 retired is still referenced somewhere, fold it rather than adding a parallel rule.

Reader: the skills-lane seat after triage.

Duplicate check: semantic searches "pm-dispatch tooling card quota product commit share round report" (objectstack, 101 hits; open near-misses #25498 filing-gate quota, #22060 rule-text diet program, neither a dispatch cap or report reading) and "spec key lands with its first reader planned liveness row spec-first rule" (11 hits, all closed, none about ordering). No duplicate.

Evidence: https://claude.ai/artifact/8qxoYjsE4jQC4DJBCF3wm5#D3 and #D5
